items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Could you see doing a record like you did with Pete -- could you see doing it, say, with Tommy Flanagan, the two of? [INTERVIEWEE] With Tommy?

ctx.x: Because there are a lot of guys that play for vocalists who are just marvelous -- say, for instance, right now, play with Ella. She's got a conductor, a pianist who I think is one of the most under-rated pianist there is. What's his name?
